Map functional requirements to system capabilities across issuer host, switch, and ancillary systems. Provide architectural input on loyalty platforms, issuer analytics/BI dashboards, real-time data streaming, revenue enhancement, and scheme cost optimization tooling, as well as AI-driven card optimization tools. Oversee architecture for card procurement and personalization/embossing workflows and vendor integrations. Evaluate, configure, and recommend platform capabilities to meet business and regulatory requirements. Provide architectural oversight for platform upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives. Design cloud-native and hybrid architectures for card issuing platforms across public/private cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, or private cloud). Define strategies for containerization, microservices, API-led connectivity, and cloud security for payment workloads. Ensure architectures meet resilience, scalability, disaster recovery, and data residency requirements specific to payments processing. Translate scheme mandates, compliance bulletins, and regulatory changes into architecture and system requirements. Ensure solutions remain compliant with PCI-DSS, EMV, 3-D Secure, tokenization standards, and other relevant payment security frameworks. Lead or support certification processes with card schemes (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) and embossing/personalization vendors. Coordinate technical certification testing, documentation, and sign-off across internal teams and external vendors. Maintain certification roadmaps and ensure timely renewal/compliance with scheme certification requirements. Enterprise Architecture Practice Apply enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF or equivalent) to ensure alignment between business strategy and technology solutions. Strategic Architecture Design Develop multi-year technology roadmaps and strategic architecture blueprints for the cards issuing business. Assess build vs. buy vs. partner options for emerging capabilities. Identify opportunities for platform consolidation, modernization, and cost optimization. 9. RFP & Presales Support Lead technical solutioning and architecture design for RFP/RFI responses related to card issuing processing. Partner with sales, presales, and product teams to craft compelling, technically sound proposals. Develop solution costing inputs, technical differentiators, and win themes for client pitches. 10. Stakeholder Presentation & Communication Present architecture solutions, roadmaps, and business cases to internal stakeholders, clients, and board members. Translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant narratives for non-technical audiences. Act as a trusted technical advisor in client-facing engagements, workshops, and steering committees. 11. Data, Analytics & BI Architecture Architect data flows supporting issuer analytics, reporting dashboards, and real-time data streaming for portfolio and transaction insights. Ensure data architecture supports revenue enhancement, scheme cost optimization, and AI/ML-driven decisioning use cases. 12. API & Integration Architecture Define API management, gateway, and integration strategies connecting core issuing systems with digital channels, fintech partners, and third-party services. Champion API-led connectivity and event-driven integration patterns across the issuing ecosystem. 13. Payment Security Architecture Architect security controls including HSM/key management, encryption, tokenization, and secure card data handling in line with PCI-DSS and scheme security requirements. Ensure architectures address data residency and in-country processing requirements mandated by local regulators/central banks. 14. DevOps, CI/CD & Site Reliability Define architecture standards for CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release management for issuer processing platforms. Establish resilience, monitoring, and observability practices to meet high-availability requirements of payment systems. 15. Vendor & Partner Management Manage technical relationships with core platform vendors, scheme partners, fraud/analytics providers, and embossing/personalization bureaus. Support vendor evaluation, due diligence, and contract/SLA negotiations from a technical architecture perspective. 16. Recommend proof-of-concept initiatives to test emerging technologies before broader rollout. 18. Team Leadership & Mentoring Provide technical leadership and mentoring to solution/technical architects and engineering teams. Foster architecture best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous capability building across the team. 19. Commercial & Cost Optimization Acumen Evaluate total cost of ownership across architecture options, including licensing, infrastructure, and operational costs. Identify opportunities for platform consolidation and cost efficiency without compromising resilience or compliance. Hands-on experience with core issuer processing platforms (Way4, Base24, Card Control) and fraud platforms (Falcon) strongly preferred. Proven experience with cloud architecture and migration projects (AWS/Azure/GCP). Strong understanding of Visa/Mastercard scheme rules, EMV, PCI-DSS, and card personalization/embossing processes. Experience leading or contributing to scheme and vendor certification processes. Enterprise architecture certification (e.g., TOGAF 9+) required or in progress. Demonstrated experience contributing to RFP responses and client-facing presales activities. Excellent presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior/board-level stakeholders. Preferred Skills Knowledge of ISO 8583 and ISO 20022 messaging standards. Familiarity with API gateways, microservices architecture, and event-driven design. Experience with HSM and key management solutions. Exposure to digital wallets, tokenization services (e.g., Visa Token Service, Mastercard MDES). Prior consulting or systems integrator experience in the payments industry. Experience with fraud/decisioning platforms (e.g., FICO Falcon, FICO Blaze Advisor, or equivalent) and AI-based fraud detection tools. Familiarity with loyalty platforms, BI/analytics dashboards, and real-time data streaming architectures. Understanding of AML/KYC frameworks and data residency/regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions. Exposure to emerging payment trends: real-time payments, open banking, BNPL/installments, embedded finance, and digital currencies. Experience with DevOps/CI-CD tooling and site reliability practices for high-availability payment systems. Key Competencies Strategic thinking and solution design Stakeholder management across technical and executive audiences Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work across matrixed, cross-functional teams Excellent verbal and written communication skills Network International is an equal opportunity employer.
